hypothesis: FCLR-H007: funding + price features improve out-of-sample forecasts of next-24h mean log realized variance (QLIKE) beyond a signed-component HAR baseline (B1) on the disjoint 2024-04..2026-10 cohort, judged on relative test-QLIKE reduction.
target: next-24h mean log realized variance log(RV_24h_next + eps)
splits: 60/20/20 by unique UTC timestamp on S; 7-day (168h) purge/embargo; test -> 3 chronological blocks

models.B1: OLS on log RV1h/RV24h/RV168h + log RV_plus/RV_minus at 24h/168h (7 signed HAR features), train-only scaling
models.C2: B1 + signed funding(24h) + trailing 90d |funding| percentile + mark/index premium + mark/EMA24 distance (11 features)

primary_contrast: C2 vs B1 on paired test-set out-of-sample QLIKE
secondary: next-24h downside realized-semivariance level log(RV_minus+eps), MSE, Holm across the declared 2-family
inference: >=2000 deterministic block-bootstrap replicates (block=24 rows, seed=20261126); report QLIKE, MSE, R^2, 95% CI on relative QLIKE reduction, per-block, leave-one-symbol-out
decision_rule: PROMOTED iff relative test-QLIKE reduction >=2% AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND test data sufficient; else NOT_SUPPORTED; INCONCLUSIVE if insufficient data
